definitions.explanation: Not special or different from what is expected.

examples.japanese: {普通|ふつう}の{生活|せいかつ}がしたい。
examples.english: I want to live a normal life.

examples.japanese: これは{普通|ふつう}の{大|おお}きさですか。
{普通|ふつう}の{電車|でんしゃ}に{乗|の}ったので、{時間|じかん}がかかった。
examples.english: I took the local train, so it took a long time.

examples.japanese: この{料理|りょうり}は{普通|ふつう}だと{思|おも}ったが、{友達|ともだち}はとても{美味|おい}しいと{言|い}った。
examples.english: I thought this dish was ordinary, but my friend said it was very delicious.

examples.japanese: {普通|ふつう}、{朝|あさ}7{時|じ}に{起|お}きる。
examples.english: I usually wake up at 7 a.m.

examples.japanese: {普通|ふつう}、{日曜日|にちようび}は{家|いえ}で{休|やす}む。
examples.english: I usually rest at home on Sundays.

examples.japanese: {普通|ふつう}、この{店|みせ}は{夜|よる}10{時|じ}まで{開|あ}いている。
examples.english: This store is usually open until 10 p.m.

examples.japanese: {普通|ふつう}は{電車|でんしゃ}で{通勤|つうきん}するが、{雨|あめ}の{日|ひ}は{車|くるま}で{行|い}くことがある。
examples.english: I usually commute by train, but on rainy days I sometimes drive.

notes:
{普通|ふつう} means ordinary, normal, or usually. It's highly versatile, functioning as a noun, な-adjective, and adverb.

AS AN ADJECTIVE:
- {普通|ふつう}の{人|ひと}: ordinary person
- {普通|ふつう}の{生活|せいかつ}: normal life
- {普通|ふつう}の{大|おお}きさ: normal size

AS AN ADVERB:
- {普通|ふつう}は～: usually ~
- {普通|ふつう}、7{時|じ}に{起|お}きる: I usually wake up at 7

TRAIN TERMINOLOGY:
{普通|ふつう}{電車|でんしゃ} (local train) stops at every station, unlike {急行|きゅうこう} (express) or {特急|とっきゅう} (limited express).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {通常|つうじょう}: usually, normally (more formal)
- {一般的|いっぱんてき}: general, typical
- {平凡|へいぼん}: ordinary, mediocre
